_comment: The two ways to give, shown first on the Donate page (web/pages/donate-app.js and native src/gui/pages/donate.rs both read this file; tests/page_parity_lint.rs fails if either stops). Set by the operator on 2026-10-04: a gift to the maintainer himself goes to Patreon 'for the time being' and is not tax-deductible; a tax-deductible donation goes to the nonprofit Sponsor-a-Can. Order in this file is the display order. Patreon is first because it is the one that funds HumanityOS: the page is titled Support HumanityOS, and the Humanity page's Fund the work buttons open it, so the first card has to be a gift to the work (review, 2026-10-04). `about` (optional) is one line on who they are, kept from the copy the page already carried. `goes_to` is the ONE plain sentence each card shows: where the money goes and whether it is tax-deductible. It must agree with `tax_deductible` (a unit test in src/gui/pages/donate.rs checks this file). Never add amounts or promises of what a gift pays for here. Sponsor-a-Can's 501(c)(3) status is checked against IRS data in docs/reference/findings/2026-10-04-sponsor-a-can-tax-status.md.

routes.name: Shaostoul on Patreon
routes.goes_to: Your gift goes to Shaostoul, the maintainer, who receives it personally, so it is not tax-deductible.

routes.name: Sponsor-a-Can
routes.about: Fights poverty through sanitation, recycling, and community clean-up for homeless and disadvantaged communities.
routes.goes_to: Your donation goes to Sponsor-a-Can, a 501(c)(3) nonprofit, so it is tax-deductible as the law allows.
routes.note: The HumanityOS maintainer serves as Sponsor-a-Can's Vice President.
